description: This file defines the 'ItemSelector' class for the Point of Sale module in ERPNext, handling item display, search, barcode scanning, and UI interactions within the POS interface.

classes.name: ItemSelector
classes.description: Class managing item selection, display, search, barcode scanning, and UI interactions in the POS interface.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ItemSelector with configuration parameters.

methods.name: inti_component
methods.description: Initializes UI components and event bindings.

methods.name: prepare_dom
methods.description: Prepares the DOM structure for the item selector UI.

methods.name: load_items_data
methods.description: Loads item data and populates the item list.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Fetches items from the server based on search parameters.

methods.name: render_item_list
methods.description: Renders the list of items in the UI.

methods.name: get_item_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for a single item.

methods.name: handle_broken_image
methods.description: Handles broken item images by replacing with item abbreviation.

methods.name: make_search_bar
methods.description: Creates search and item group filter controls.

methods.name: set_search_value
methods.description: Sets the search input value programmatically.

methods.name: bind_events
methods.description: Binds event handlers for barcode scanning, item selection, and search input.

methods.name: attach_shortcuts
methods.description: Adds keyboard shortcuts for search and item group focus.

methods.name: filter_items
methods.description: Filters items based on search term.

methods.name: add_filtered_item_to_cart
methods.description: Adds the currently filtered item to the cart.

methods.name: resize_selector
methods.description: Adjusts the UI layout for minimized or expanded view.

methods.name: toggle_component
methods.description: Shows or hides the item selector component.
